ab_drovers_in_the_sand.accept_append: They are still on the old road at Cartfall, west of camp, and at the First Hole beyond it.

ab_the_long_collapse.accept_append: The Long Collapse is south-west of camp, on past the Wide Sink. Sinkhole lurkers den under the rim. Kill the ones you meet and bring me their spurs - the spur tells me how deep they came up from.
labels: the north rim of the Long Collapse

ab_up_through_the_floor.accept_append: The nearest of them are at Cartfall, west of camp, and along the Glasswall to the south.

ab_the_throats.accept_append: The Throats are in the far south-west, the whole desert away from this camp. The wet things are deepwater horrors. Kill them at the rim and cut the scale off them while it is still wet.

ab_feeding_from_below.accept_append: The Glasswall, south of camp, has the most of them in one place.

sub_accept: a shard of the Glasswall, the face south of camp,
The pit down the east side, south of camp. Underlight,
ab_the_wrong_direction.accept_append: Deepwater horrors come up out of Underlight after dark. Kill the ones on the rim before you stand on it.

ab_lit_from_below.accept_append: Underlight is south of camp, down the east side, past the Glasswall. That is the glasswall elementals, the hollowing oozes, and a still-wet scale off each deepwater horror you can reach.

sub: Both bottomless pits are on the east side, and east is where the ground is worst.

sub_accept: Both of the two are east.
Underlight is south of here, down the east side. The Throats are in the far south-west.
ab_the_two_without.accept_append: Deepwater horrors climb out of both. Kill what you meet on each rim.

sub_accept: twice, both on the east side.
ab_everything_points_east.accept_append: Underlight is south of camp, down the east side. Start there. Bring me wet scale off the deepwater horrors, and put down the saltbone revenants on the way - they walk the ground between here and there.

ab_is_it_possible.accept_append: What I need is the settled residue the hollowing oozes leave behind. Take it off the oozes themselves.

ab_nine_have_floors.accept_append: What is on those floors is limestone crawlers. Clear them before the line goes down.

ab_managed_not_solved.accept_append: That means the sinkhole lurkers and the limestone crawlers. Kill both, and bring me the lurkers' spurs so I can show Peska the count.

ab_three_month_contract.accept_append: The saltbone revenants and the sinkhole lurkers are what make that run dangerous. Kill them along it.
